errors.text_span: Секторите са подредени по низходящ размер на процентите.
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that the sectors are arranged in descending order of their percentages. Visually, the sectors are not ordered by size. Starting from the top and going clockwise, the percentages are 13.6%, 9.1%, 40.9%, and 36.4%, which is not a descending order.
The description fails to mention that the data is based on 22 answers ("22 отговора"), which is explicitly stated below the chart's title.
